tmp:1763: aseret ha-dibrot im ha-luchot — the Ten Commandments together with the stone Tablets, symbolizing the yud-vav that spell the melupum vowel (Tablets six-by-six handbreadths = vav)
tmp:1764: nitmale ha-chisaron — the filling of a deficiency/lack, the state signified by melupum read as 'melo pum,' a full mouth ('open your mouth wide and I will fill it')
tmp:1765: the war Mashiach will wage and all the conquests he will conquer — the Messiah's future military campaign, fought entirely through prayer (his 'nose'/chotem weapon)
tmp:1768: ta'avat ashirut — the lust/craving for wealth, a vice identified with fallen Malkhut (money-hoarding of the Sitra Achra)
tmp:1769: cherev nokemet — 'the avenging sword' of Leviticus 26:25, a scriptural phrase identified with Malkhut/Lower Wisdom (the tzaddik's rebuking blade)
tmp:1771: yirat Elokim — the fear/awe of God as a spiritual quality, identified with Malkhut per 'were it not for the fear of the government' (Avot 3)
tmp:1772: Yisrael as the nation who accepts God's kingship — Israel in their role as the people constituting Malkhut, since 'there is no king without a people'
tmp:1774: yeshut — existence/being, the totality of manifest 'is-ness' identified with Malkhut, which draws its vitality from the Infinite Will (ratzon Ein Sof)
tmp:1775: Moav — the nation/land of Moab, symbol of Malkhut because King David descended from it (Moses buried 'in the land of Moab')
tmp:1776: retzonot — the divine wills/desires embodied in the forms of the letters, expressions of God's Malkhut drawing vitality from the Will of Ein Sof
tmp:1777: temunot — the graphic forms/shapes of the Hebrew letters, each embodying a divine will and revealing God's Malkhut
tmp:1778: the letter Nun — the alphabet letter symbolizing Malkhut/kingship, per 'yinnon shmo' (Ps. 72:17) which Rashi reads as a term of kingship
tmp:1779: d'leit lah mi-garmah klum — 'it has nothing of its own,' the kabbalistic defining property of Malkhut/the moon, receiving all from Chokhmah (the sun/Chet)
tmp:1781: malkhut d'sitra achra — the kingdom/kingship of the Other Side, the demonic counter-Malkhut personified by Haman, hoarder of holy sparks as money
tmp:1783: malkhut nittaken — the rectification/repair of the sefirah Malkhut, effected through Judah's confession recalled by Moses ('Hear, O Lord, the voice of Judah')
tmp:1784: avonotav — a person's sins/iniquities, the transgressions that degrade Malkhut and arouse the King's wrath (atoned by the Torah scholar/Moses)
tmp:1785: menagen bikhlei zemer — playing musical instruments as a spiritual act: gathering the good spirit out of the depressed/evil spirit to form holy melody
tmp:1786: chamrei — 'his donkey' (Aramaic, from the Choni sleeper tale) bearing herds, symbol of wealth per 'Yissachar is a strong-boned donkey'
tmp:1787: ha-ochez b'midat emet — one who holds fast to the trait of truthfulness, whose livelihood thereby flows amply ('kushta ka'ei' — truth stands, sustaining one's money)
tmp:1788: se'udah — a festive meal/banquet (from 'ein hasibah ela se'udah' on 'vayasev Elokim'), symbol of parnassah/sustenance, grain and food, the 'well'
tmp:1790: the obstacle is automatically broken — the state in which intensified desire (cheshek) shatters the barrier, since obstacles exist only to increase longing
tmp:1791: mimekomo — 'from His place' (of the Kedushah 'blessed be God's glory from His place'), identified with Keter, the supernal Crown
tmp:1792: drawing the spirit of life from the tzaddik of the generation — the act of receiving ruach chayim from the generation's righteous master, who is attached to Torah
tmp:1793: drawing new intellect from the Light of the Countenance — the act of importing fresh sekhel 'from afar' (Prov. 31:14) via faithful commerce/plain Torah study
tmp:1794: drawing down length of days, thereby meriting da'at — extending one's days/measures via vocal Torah study that calls the life-force into them
tmp:1795: the dominion and power of the tzaddik earned through his divine service — the 'staff' (mateh) by which all enemies above and below are subdued
tmp:1796: Torah study and speaking good words — the devotional speech-acts that sweeten the gevurot (severities) inherent in all utterance
tmp:1797: sweetening the words, which are gevurot — the mitigation of the five severities embodied in speech, accomplished through Torah study and good words
tmp:1798: hearing one's own praise recounted — the situation of listening to others tell one's virtues, which inevitably arouses self-aggrandizement
tmp:1799: the inevitability that some grandiosity will arise — the impossibility of avoiding a feeling of self-importance when praised (context of Moses' 'erase me' prayer)
tmp:1800: menagen ba-yad — playing music by hand (as 'when the musician played, the hand of God came upon him'), joy-producing act that subdues the imaginative faculty
tmp:1801: manhig — a leader/ruler (from 'dabar echad l'dor,' one spokesman per generation), the leadership sense of 'davar' identified with Malkhut
tmp:1802: meniot — obstacles/hindrances on the spiritual path, symbolized by firmaments (raki'in) that screen and divide the desirer from the desired
tmp:1803: mesirat nefesh al kiddush Hashem — self-sacrifice/martyrdom for the sanctification of God's Name, the trait of Yosef uniting chasadim and gevurot
tmp:1804: lomed b'iyun — studying Torah in depth/analytically, the intensive mode of learning (vs. casting off the Torah's yoke)
tmp:1805: me'ayen u-mevin chokhmot ha-Torah — one who delves into and comprehends the wisdoms of the Torah, an intellectual attainment
tmp:1806: 'chokhmat adam ta'ir panav' — the verse 'a man's wisdom lights up his face' (Eccl. 8:1), prooftext that Torah wisdom illuminates the countenance
tmp:1807: sippurei ma'asiyot — telling stories/tales (of tzaddikim), the practice that awakens people from spiritual sleep and draws wealth
tmp:1808: awakening from sleep — the arousal from spiritual slumber (the fallen state of the seventy faces), effected through told stories
tmp:1809: performing the mitzvah with joy — doing commandments in simchah, which completes the holiness and lifts vitality out of the kelipot (eleven incense-spices)
